title: Fix spotlight source radius reflected args
objective: Fix the new spotlight source-radius controls so they do not trigger Unreal reflected function argument assertions during orbit render.
instructions: Investigate the render failure in .control-tower/runs/soft_flashlight_falloff_validation_20260702T145744Z/render.log: after recooking cafeteria v2, render reaches scene setup then Unreal asserts in UnrealUtils::callFunction because args are not a subset of reflected property_descs.

Likely cause: apply_spot_light_shape_controls calls SetSourceRadius and SetSoftSourceRadius with NewValue=..., but UE 5.5 UPointLightComponent.h declares these BlueprintCallable methods as SetSourceRadius(float bNewValue) and SetSoftSourceRadius(float bNewValue).

Update examples/flashlight/run.py and examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py so source radius and soft source radius setters use reflected argument names that will not assert. Prefer the local helper pattern and preserve robust fallback behavior.
Make sure the helper does not first call a known-wrong reflected argument name that can pause/assert the simulator before fallback.
Update tests to catch the bNewValue argument name for source-radius methods and prevent regression.
Run the focused unit test suite: /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/envs/spear-env/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation
constraints: Do not run long Unreal renders; Tower/Experimenter will rerun visual validation after the code fix.
expected_outputs: Result packet listing changed files, tests run, and whether Inspector should review.
definition_of_done: Unit tests pass and code no longer calls SetSourceRadius/SetSoftSourceRadius with the reflected arg name that caused the assertion.
